import 'dart:io';

/// A file that belongs to this process: its id is in the name.
File _ledger() => File('${Directory.systemTemp.path}/hazard_ledger_$pid.txt');

void clear() {
  if (_ledger().existsSync()) {
    _ledger().deleteSync();
  }
}

void enter(String line) {
  _ledger().writeAsStringSync('$line\n', mode: FileMode.append);
}

int entries() => _ledger().readAsLinesSync().length;
